comfyui.skybox_prompt: equirectangular 360 panorama, skybox, seamless, clear horizon, wide open environment, smooth zenith and nadir, avoid pole artifacts, no tiny planet
comfyui.depth_prompt: three depth layers, foreground framing with branches, leaves, rocks, grass; midground path, cottages, fences; distant mountains, treeline, sky; atmospheric perspective, distant desaturated bluish haze; ground texture detail fades with distance; contact shadows; leading lines (path, river, fence, light beams); single directional sunlight with soft fill
